title: Encryption — gpg_encrypt
text: Encrypt decrypt message using public key receiver. Optionally message can signed using private key sender.

title: Encryption — gpg_encrypt
code: gpg_encrypt(data, receiver, signer = NULL)  gpg_decrypt(data, verify = TRUE, as_text = TRUE)

title: Encryption — gpg_encrypt
text: data path raw vector data encrypt / decrypt receiver key id(s) fingerprint(s) recepient(s) signer (optional) key id(s) fingerprint(s) sender(s) sign message verify automatically checks signatures () can verified raises error otherwise as_text convert output text. Set FALSE expect binary data.

title: Manage the GPG engine — gpg_restart
text: Use gpg_restart() find gpg program home directory (contains configuration keychains). Usually default fine need run function manually.

title: Manage the GPG engine — gpg_restart
code: gpg_restart(home = NULL, path = NULL, debug = "none", silent = FALSE)  gpg_version(silent = FALSE)  gpg_info()  gpg_options()

title: Manage the GPG engine — gpg_restart
text: home path GPG configuration directory (including keyrings) path location gpg gpg2 gpgconf (windows) gpgme-w32spawn.exe debug debugging level, integer 1 9 silent suppress output gpg --version

title: Manage the GPG engine — gpg_restart
text: Use gpg_info() get current engine settings. gpg_version() function simply calls gpg --version see verbose output gpg executable. gpg_options reads options GnuPG configuration file, stored default ~/.gnupg/gpg.conf. Note changing options might affect software using GnuPG.

title: GPG keyring management — gpg_keys

code: gpg_import(file)  gpg_recv(id, search = NULL, keyserver = NULL)  gpg_send(id, keyserver = NULL)  gpg_delete(id, secret = FALSE)  gpg_export(id, secret = FALSE)  gpg_list_keys(search = "", secret = FALSE)  gpg_list_signatures(id)
